pre_execution_correction.change: Corrected the textual packing description from five-trits-per-byte radix-5 to the 203-bit-per-128-trit base-3 layout used by the already-frozen byte projection; no numeric gate, byte count, model scope, data, or fit setting changed

objective: Falsify or promote one CPU-runnable whole-model representation by quantizing every rank-2-or-higher weight in complete early, middle, and late Qwen3.8-27B transformer blocks and measuring disjoint held-out block-output error

scope.coverage: Every rank-2-or-higher weight in each selected block, including all attention or linear-attention projections, linear-attention convolution weights, and all MLP projections; rank-1 norms remain exact
scope.claim_boundary: A three-complete-block falsification gate for a representation intended to cover all 64 text blocks; not a whole-model artifact, capability result, runtime result, or breakthrough

representation.name: group128 affine base3 plus shared learned Givens butterfly
representation.weight_equation: For each 128-weight group, W_hat[g,j] = mu[g] + alpha[g] * t[g,j], with t in {-1,0,+1}; every group therefore has exactly three reconstructed values and exactly one base-3 code per weight
representation.rotation_equation: For a shared activation site with orthogonal R, replace each consumer W by Q_affine(W * R^T) and evaluate it on R * x; R is a product of six disjoint-pair Givens stages and is never materialized as a dense matrix
representation.fanout_sharing: One rotation is shared by every projection consuming the same normalized activation, including q/k/v-style fanout and gate/up fanout
representation.convolution_rule: Small linear-attention convolution kernels use the same affine base-3 group algebra after row flattening but no activation rotation
representation.ternary_packing: Each complete 128-trit group is one canonical 203-bit base-3 integer with digits 0,1,2; groups reset at rows and no padding is counted between rows
representation.alpha_storage: One FP16 row anchor and one per-tensor 16-entry FP16 log-ratio codebook with packed 4-bit group indices
representation.mu_storage: One signed FP16 row anchor and one per-tensor 16-entry FP16 signed-ratio codebook with packed 4-bit group indices
representation.rotation_storage: Three FP16 angle equivalents, or six bytes, per activation dimension because each of six stages contains dimension/2 angles; deterministic pairings and signs are regenerated from model revision, layer, site, and stage
representation.runtime_equation: For each group, accumulate alpha[g] * dot(t[g], x[g]) + mu[g] * sum(x[g]); apply each shared Givens product once per activation site and never reconstruct BF16 or FP16 weights

complete_text_projection.accounting_rule: Codes, alpha and mu indices, anchors, codebooks, rotations, descriptors, exact retained tensors, headers, alignment, metadata, and auxiliary model files all count

activation_protocol.source: Exact authenticated BF16 parent, streamed one complete transformer block at a time on CPU
activation_protocol.row_selection: Deterministic equally spaced token rows after separately tokenizing the frozen calibration and validation texts
activation_protocol.separation: Calibration and validation texts are disjoint; neither split contains a CUTE, MATH-500, sealed code-trace, MMLU, or WikiText evaluation item
activation_protocol.cache_contents: Exact input and exact output of each complete selected block plus authenticated position and mask inputs required to replay that block
activation_protocol.propagation: Layer 32 and layer 63 inputs are produced by sequential exact BF16 block propagation, not by embedding-only or synthetic proxies
calibration_texts: Explain why a reversible storage codec and a lossy weight quantizer require different correctness tests.
Compute 73 times 29 and verify the answer using subtraction from 73 times 30.
Write a Python function that returns the indices of all local maxima in a numeric list.
Describe two reasons a language model can have lower reconstruction error but worse free generation.
En espanol, explica por que una evaluacion debe permanecer separada de los datos de entrenamiento.
A machine completes five ninths of a job in 35 minutes at constant speed. Find the total time.
Give JSON arguments for a weather tool that requests a three day forecast for Helsinki.
Contrast memory bandwidth and arithmetic throughput for single-token transformer decoding.
validation_texts: A jar contains red, blue, and green marbles in the ratio 2:3:5. What fraction are not green?
Implement a stable deduplication function that preserves the first appearance of each item.
Why can selecting hyperparameters on a benchmark invalidate the final benchmark conclusion?
Summarize how per-group scales affect the honest bits-per-weight of a ternary model.
activation_protocol.text_manifest_note: The exact disjoint text lists were added before activation collection or fit; row ceilings, optimization settings, thresholds, and storage accounting were already frozen and did not change

fit.baseline: Direct symmetric group-128 optimal-MSE ternary weights with one alpha and zero mu, evaluated over the same complete blocks and held-out rows
fit.candidate: Affine group-128 ternary weights plus six-stage shared Givens rotations
fit.initial_codes: Deterministic weighted three-cluster assignment around the activation-weighted group mean
fit.affine_update: For fixed trits, solve the two-parameter activation-metric least-squares system for mu and alpha; alpha must remain non-negative
fit.code_update: One deterministic coordinate pass over -1,0,+1 under the exact cached activation residual followed by one final affine solve
fit.rotation_update: Eight full-coverage hard-forward straight-through steps over all consumer rows at each activation site; accumulate gradients across deterministic output-row shards before one angle update
fit.no_sweep: Layer set, row counts, stage count, steps, learning rate, group size, threshold, and storage ceiling are frozen for this family

falsification_gate.metric: sum squared candidate-minus-parent complete-block output divided by sum squared parent complete-block output on the disjoint validation rows
falsification_gate.pass_action: Run one restartable 64-layer sequential conversion, export one complete packed artifact, then run CUTE, MATH-500, sealed code, WikiText, MMLU-type, and paired CPU throughput gates
falsification_gate.reject_action: Terminate affine-butterfly as a hypothesis family without changing thresholds, layer choices, rank, stage count, calibration items, or optimizer settings

required: energy and cost per generated token

whole_model_promotion_gates.breakthrough_claim_requires: A complete runnable 26895998464-parameter text artifact passing honest storage, free-generation capability, perplexity, and paired CPU runtime gates

stop_conditions: Any selected block fails to improve held-out complete-block NMSE by at least 30 percent
Projected honest complete-text storage exceeds 1.70 bits per parameter
Rotation and auxiliary storage exceeds 0.10 bits per parameter
Any selected block or linear family is omitted
Any source, cache, denominator, payload, or repository identity is unauthenticated
Any non-finite value, incomplete row shard, or pack-unpack mismatch occurs
Infrastructure-invalid execution is recorded and retried without being scored as a scientific rejection
